commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

id.description: A session's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints (never the provider's resume id), kept in lowercase.

title.description: The user's title; the fallback when absent.

tags.description: Tags to start with; duplicates ignoring case keep the latest casing.

items.description: A free-form tag: 1 to 40 characters once trimmed, no control characters; stored trimmed, unique per session ignoring case.

groupId.description: A group on this environment to put the session in; none when absent or null.

anyOf.description: A group's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints, kept in lowercase.

path.description: The directory on the environment's machine.

workspace.description: Where a session's code lives on its environment: its kind and path.

account.description: The account the session's runs use; the adapter workstream's to validate.

model.description: The model the session's runs use; the adapter workstream's to validate.

mode.description: The mode the session's runs start in, clamped at each run; permissions.mode.set changes it.
